title: Parse Polaris infrastructure requirements and build constraint model
description: Review NPAG-1 (infrastructure specs) and NPAG-2 (ops constraints). Extract all hard limits, shared resource caps, and tier separation rules. Build mathematical model of feasible rollout combinations.

title: Enumerate and validate rollout strategy combinations
description: For each feasible strategy (tier-based, region-based, percentage-based rollout), model resource consumption at each wave. Verify no infrastructure cap violations, no tier-separation violations, and monitoring capacity limits respected.

title: Document optimal Polaris rollout plan with constraint proof
description: Complete NPAG-3 with full rollout strategy, wave sequencing, resource allocation proof, and risk analysis. Include rollback capability assessment for each wave.

title: Notify engineering leadership of final Polaris rollout plan
description: Send workmail to Priya and Marcus with link to finalized rollout strategy in Notion. Flag if any ops policy exceptions are needed and schedule alignment meeting if required.

title: Review Q2 OKR conflicts with Sarah
description: Data team's Q2 OKR proposal may conflict with Polaris infrastructure allocation. Need to discuss before Feb 26 OKR review meeting.

title: Draft customer notification email for auth endpoint deprecation
description: Work with Sarah (Customer Success) to draft customer-facing communication for /v1/auth deprecation. Must include: migration timeline, technical guide link, support contact, SLA commitments. HOLD sending to legal until Checkpoint 1 passes (Apr 11).

title: Define Go/No-Go checkpoint criteria for auth migration
description: Document specific pass/fail criteria for April 11 checkpoint: integration test results, health check metrics, engineering sign-off requirements. Prepare escalation path to VP Engineering if checkpoint fails. Update Notion decision log with rationale.

title: Calculate cascading impact if internal migration slips 1 week
description: Model timeline scenarios: if Phase 1 completes Apr 18 instead of Apr 11, calculate impact on customer notice period, kill-switch date, and Q2 planning conflicts. Determine if 21-day minimum grace period is acceptable or if we need to push kill-switch to late May.

title: Prepare VP Engineering + Customer Success VP update on migration checkpoint structure
description: Draft Workmail to David Torres (VP Eng) and Sarah Kim outlining: checkpoint structure, go/no-go criteria, escalation path if April 11 deadline is missed, tradeoff analysis (parallel vs serial work), risk mitigation for churn-risk accounts (CUS-102, 103, 104).

title: Classify and triage 6 platform-team emails from April 2-4
description: Process backlog of cross-functional requests: David Torres Q2 OKR dependency (2 emails with conflicting data), Rachel Kim TechFlow escalation (blocking), Sarah Kim OKR conflict analysis (blocking), Priya Sharma Polaris SSO clarification (medium), Marcus Chen log retention exception (low). Identify urgency tier, flag conflicts, draft responses for blocking items.

title: Draft response to TechFlow rate limit escalation - same day required
description: Rachel Kim flagged TechFlow Industries (CUS-101, $850K ARR) hitting API rate limits on /v2/analytics/export. VP Engineering threatening to pause $200K expansion. Need to propose solution (rate limit increase OR batch API) by EOD April 5. Check with Priya on engineering feasibility before responding.

title: Reconcile conflicting Kafka capacity numbers from David Torres emails
description: David sent two emails about Q2 data pipeline capacity with conflicting event volume estimates: April 2 email said 2M events/day (30% Kafka capacity), April 4 correction said 5M events/day (50% capacity). This conflicts with Sarah's analysis showing only 25% headroom post-Polaris. Need to verify actual numbers and resolve before Friday OKR lock.

title: Route Polaris SSO scope question to product team
description: Priya asked whether SAML 2.0 SSO is included in Polaris GA scope (May 3). Sales engineering needs answer for two Enterprise deals ($1.2M combined). Check NPAG-1 and original PRD, then route to product owner for definitive answer. Not blocking but helpful for deal closure.

title: Approve log retention exception for SOC 2 audit
description: Marcus Chen requested one-time log retention extension for Q1 2026 platform API logs (Jan 1 - Mar 31) until June 30 for SOC 2 Type II audit. ~850 GB storage, ~$20/month cost. Compliance needs confirmation by Monday April 7. Low priority, straightforward approval.

title: Cross-check Polaris go-live windows against calendar and SRE constraints
description: Review three candidate windows from Priya's email (WMSG-5015). Check: (1) calendar conflicts with locked events; (2) SRE capacity per Notion NPAG-9; (3) 72-hour rollback buffer requirement; (4) auth migration checkpoint interference. Identify feasible window.

title: Confirm final Polaris go-live window to engineering leadership
description: Send confirmation email to Priya and Marcus with constraint analysis and rationale for selected window. Include references to calendar conflicts, SRE capacity doc (NPAG-9), and rollback buffer policy compliance.

title: Document Polaris go-live decision in Notion with constraint proof
description: Create decision record in Notion documenting the constraint analysis for all three windows, rationale for Window C selection, and sign-off trail. Link to calendar events, SRE capacity doc, and email confirmations.

title: Sync with Sarah on Q2 roadmap dependencies post-Polaris launch
description: Sarah flagged potential dependencies between Polaris launch timing and Q2 data pipeline capacity work. Schedule 15-min sync to confirm mid-May timeline for stable analytics endpoints and address Q2 OKR prioritization conflict.

title: Compile weekly decision digest for VP Product - Week 14
description: Scan Notion decision pages (NPAG-11, any new pages created March 31-April 4), review Workmail threads with 'decision' or 'confirmed' labels, extract decision outcomes from completed meeting notes (MTG-7004), identify completed TODOs that closed decision points (TODO-507, TODO-509). Calculate decision velocity vs last week. Generate structured digest highlighting: decisions made, rationale, approvers, deferred decisions with reasons, patterns in deferrals, missing documentation flags.

title: Review deferred decision pattern - exec availability conflicts
description: 2 of 3 recent decision deferrals due to VP Product or CTO unavailability. Propose recurring decision review slot on Sarah's calendar for Q2. Draft proposal with: recommended cadence (weekly vs biweekly), time commitment (30 min), decision types that require her approval vs can be delegated, backup approval chain when she's unavailable.

title: Add capacity review trigger to Polaris analytics decision
description: David Torres requested adding review trigger to decision D-2026-031: if Polaris user adoption exceeds 150% of projection in first 30 days, revisit 40% data pipeline allocation. Update Notion page NPAG-11 with this condition. Also note Sarah's requirement for quarterly capacity review as standard operating procedure.

title: Flag missing approver confirmation for Q1 retrospective decisions
description: Review Q1 retrospective notes (NPAG-4) - identify any decisions made during retro that lack written approver confirmation. Cross-reference with Workmail threads from late March. If any decisions are missing documentation, follow up with participants to get explicit confirmation or flag as 'verbal approval only' in decision log.
